name: Paint timing (FCP, LCP) and Core Web Vitals
plain: Reports when content first appeared and the largest element rendered.
meaning: PerformancePaintTiming and LargestContentfulPaint give render timings that reflect network, CPU and GPU. Cross-origin images need Timing-Allow-Origin for full detail.

limits.headline: Can check when content first showed and how long the biggest item took
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens as the page loads
can: Get time to first content and time to the largest picture or block
Learn how fast your network, processor and graphics are
Get fuller detail for outside images only if their site allows it
cannot: Know who you are by itself
See full detail for other sites' images without their approval

story.what_it_is: Browsers report when the first content appeared and when the biggest item finished drawing.

marketing.name: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
marketing.pitch: Google says LCP measures how soon the main content of a page appears, as one of its Core Web Vitals.

marketing.name: Web Vitals
marketing.pitch: Google describes a set of simple measures of real user experience, to help sites improve speed.

story.for_you: You never see the measure, but you feel it as how fast a page seems to load. Pages that show their main content quickly feel better and tend to rank higher in Google.
story.for_makers: These numbers feed Google's Core Web Vitals, so they affect search ranking, ad revenue and sales. Teams track them from real visitors and fix slow images and scripts.

use_cases.example: A retailer tracks how fast the main product photo appears and sees that faster pages sell more.
A news site fixes a slow hero image because search and ads depend on a fast first view.
An ad network watches that its ad slot does not push the main content later, since publishers get graded on it.
A game portal checks how fast the game page and play button show up, to stop people leaving.
Real user monitoring tools show LCP by country, device and network.
A video site makes sure the poster image and play button appear first, before heavy scripts.
A booking site compares paint times on slow phones to decide what to trim.

technical_bounds: Cross-origin elements without TAO are exposed only with limited info
